 Arising Out of Ps. Case No.-54 Year-2024 Thana- Pranpur District

sentences.text:
======================================================
 Lobin Singh
 ... ... Petitioner/s
 Versus
 The State of Bihar
 ... ... Opposite Party/s
 ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Md Musowir
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Awadhesh Kumar Singh
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Justice Smt. Soni Shrivastava
 Oral Order
4 11-04-2025 Heard learned Counsel for the petitioner and learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.
2. The present application is for grant of anticipatory bail, in connection with Pranpur P.S. Case No.54 of 2024 for offences under Sections 341, 323, 498A, 504, 506/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. Both the parties are agreeable to go before the Mediation Center in order to reach an amicable settlement.
Let the matter be placed before the Mediation Center and both the parties are directed to appear on 22nd April, 2025.
In the meantime, no coercive steps shall be taken against the petitioner.

(Soni Shrivastava, J) sharun/-
